rationale: The only implementation delta is the arithmetic used to calculate the tile's upper bounds: the fixed version uses saturating unsigned addition to avoid overflow, whereas the vulnerable version directly computes (p + 1) * tdx and (q + 1) * tdy before casting. The Logic section merely states that tile extent is calculated from the image and coding parameters; this is true of both versions and does not specify either arithmetic mechanism or an overflow-related guard. Its statements about iterating through components and resolutions and updating minimum precinct sizes and maximum precision also hold on both sides.
